text: Pip Halyard, Regatta Master! You've the look of someone who thinks they're fast.
Stormbreak regatta! Eight buoys, one lap, the stacks don't care how pretty your sails are.
Wind's {weather} today. Perfect racing weather. It's always perfect racing weather.
Lightning and gales! Best racing day of the year! Probably the last, too, if you're unlucky.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Start the clock! (or give up a run)

text: Talk to me to start the clock, get in a boat, and round all eight buoys in order: yellow first, then sunwise round the island, then back to the yellow.
Under seventy-five seconds pays thirty doubloons. The record's announced to the whole Reach.
Cut close inside the stacks on the far side, but not too close. They bite.
A schooner's the fastest hull afloat. Just saying.
Raise full sail on the straights, half sail on the bends.
Because nowhere else in the Reach has wind like Stormbreak. If you can sail here, you can sail anywhere.
